title: Cognate
summary: COGNATE, adjective 1. Allied by blood; kindred by birth. 2. Related in origin; proceeding from the same stock; of the same family; as a cognate dialect. 3. Allied in the manner of formation or utteran

inlines.v: COGNATE, adjective 1. Allied by blood; kindred by birth. 2. Related in origin; proceeding from the same stock; of the same family; as a cognate dialect. 3. Allied in the manner of formation or utterance; uttered by the same organs; as a cognate letter or round.
